name: Tractor Supply Distribution Center Macon GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Divided-boulevard truck entrance off Tractor Dr; gate arms / sliding gates span both inbound and outbound lanes with a perimeter fence line continuing to either side (z21 imagery at 32.7281,-83.7301).
fieldNotes.guardShack: White booth structure seated in the median island straddling the gate lanes, ~1-2 vehicle footprint; staff vehicles parked on the median beside it. Driver reviews cite helpful on-site security staff.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: The entrance is a divided boulevard with a landscaped median; the guard booth sits on the median with a gated inbound lane on one side and a gated outbound lane on the other.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided gate apron with generous paved width on the outbound side and a large pre-gate truck turnaround/staging apron, leaving room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.scale: Web/driver sources (TruckMap, maconchamber) report a CAT Scale on site; consistent with a 24/7 drop-and-hook DC.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on different building faces: a long dock line on the NW face and a second dock line on the SW face.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted from z18-z20 rhythm of bays/trailers across the NW and SW faces; well over 50 doors total (estimate ~110, flagged uncertain).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple large drop-yard lots NW and W of the building with many rows of parked trailers (drop-and-hook); far exceeds 50 stalls.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-Macon industrial park along the I-75 corridor surrounded by woods and open fields; small-town-industrial setting, classified Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.multiStep: No clearly visible second checkpoint after the gate in overhead imagery; left false. The CAT scale is in the yard but a discrete second guard stage is not confirmed.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is unrelated.
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: Both nearest panos are 2012-05 pre-construction frames of the then-empty pad (Google has not re-driven the internal road), but metadata status is OK within 400m, so hasCoverage=true with the real pano ids recorded.
